paragraphs: Nowadays, people can use a computer to view historical objects and works of art. For this reason, some people think that public museums and art galleries will no longer be necessary. Personally, I am of the opposite school of thought: technology is useful, yet it cannot replace museums and galleries.

Admittedly, technology has made it much easier for people to explore historical and artistic works from home. High-resolution images, three-dimensional reconstructions and virtual reality platforms enable viewers to explore masterpieces and ancient artifacts in remarkable detail without leaving home. One clear example is Louvre museum, where people can use a virtual museum tour to see famous paintings and historical objects on a computer without travelling to different countries. In addition, these technologies are useful for people who cannot afford travel or have mobility issues, as they can still access a vast range of cultural and historical heritages.

However, I believe that public museums and art galleries are necessary. First, online experience cannot replicate the direct sensory engagement of seeing an artefact or artwork in person. In fact, seeing these objects directly can evoke emotions and a sense of authenticity that digital images cannot convey. For example, viewing a historical artefact in person may make its age and authenticity more vivid than an image can. Moreover, museums and galleries are vital cultural hubs that symbolize the identity of a region. They can attract visitors from different places while giving local people an opportunity to learn more about their culture and history. These venues can also foster bonding within the community.
In conclusion, although computers and modern technology allow people to access historical objects, I believe that public museums and art galleries will remain important.

annotations.explanation: “Computer” là danh từ đếm được số ít trong câu này; em cần thêm “a” trước danh từ khi nói đến một thiết bị bất kỳ.

annotations.explanation: Em dùng “because ... but” để nối hai mệnh đề, khiến lý do đồng ý một phần và ý phản đối đứng lẫn nhau; trong văn phong lớp cũng không dùng “but” để triển khai. Cần nêu lợi ích thật rồi chốt không thể thay thế.

annotations.errorTypeLabel: Cặp đối lập lệch chức năng

annotations.explanation: Body 1 đang thừa nhận một lợi ích thật của công nghệ, không khẳng định bảo tàng nên biến mất; Body 2 bảo vệ bảo tàng. Theo dàn ý này, dùng “Admittedly” để nhận ích lợi rồi “However” để bác kết luận thay thế.

annotations.title: Mạo từ trước tour
annotations.explanation: “Tour” là danh từ đếm được số ít, nên không thể đứng trần sau “use”; thêm “a” trước cụm này khi nói về một chuyến tham quan ảo.

task.text:
Some people claim that public museums and art galleries will be no longer needed because people can see historical objects and works of art by using a computer.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
